notes: Real clip (window 0.80-1.97 s, previs frames 173-201): low chase shot of the pearl-white R32-style coupe on a wet, empty, multi-lane night highway. Camera ~0.6 m above the road, in the lane to the LEFT of the car, ~4.7 m behind / 2.8 m left of the car centre (~5.5 m away), pitch ~0, no roll, aimed so the image centre falls on the car's rear-left wheel arch / quarter panel. The car is seen from the rear-left three-quarter (about 32-35 deg off its axis): rear face + left flank, nose pointing away and to the left of frame. It spans x 24-82% of the frame width (centre ~53%), wing top ~29% and tyre bottoms ~73% of the height. Horizon (end of road / far lights) at ~51% height; the road / car-axis vanishing point is just off-screen left (x ~ -8%), a dashed lane mark runs from the lower-left toward it, a lane line crosses the lower-right, a small green gantry sign sits far left, sky is black. Camera motion over the window: very gentle chase push-in (car grows ~5-6% in width: front wheel drifts ~15 px left, bumper ~25 px right at 1280 px), horizon fixed, no visible roll or shake. Previs: car at the origin, yaw 0 (+Y), convoy speed 21 m/s; lens 30 mm (landmark + vanishing-point least-squares fit gave 27-29 mm, the front/rear wheel size ratio suggests up to 35-40 mm, so 30 is a compromise); camera (-2.83,-4.68,0.64) -> (-2.75,-4.50,0.63), i.e. a ~0.2 m push-in along the view axis, aimed at the rear-left quarter (-0.56,-1.39,0.66) -> (-0.45,-1.23,0.64). Fitted with Levenberg-Marquardt to hand-measured landmarks (both wheels, rear bumper corners, tail-lights, road vanishing point) at 0.8 / 1.4 / 2.0 s, then verified with 50% blends at 5 times: front wheel, bumper corners and tail-lights within 1-3% of the frame width (<= 30 px at 1280), car width within ~3%, vanishing point x = -96..-110 px vs -90..-113 real, horizon within 1% of the height, wheel-contact-line slope 0.26-0.27 vs 0.25 real, push-in ~5% vs 5.6% real; no discontinuity (frame-difference max/median 1.5). Remaining mismatches: the grey-box wing is much higher and further forward than the real GT-R wing (~70 px = 10% of frame height too high, left end ~120 px too far left); the previs rear wheel is ~20-30 px (2-3% of width) right of the real one (grey-box wheelbase 2.78 m vs ~2.6 m real) and the roofline is lower and boxier; the previs has tall grey skyline boxes behind the car where the real background is black sky (builder skyline); the convoy speed cannot be measured from the clip: the real roadside sign grows x1.28 over the window while the previs gantry grows ~x1.5 (a stationary sign would need ~14 m/s), speed 21 was kept so the 10-spoke wheels alias into a slow forward spin instead of a backwards wagon-wheel; lens stays uncertain between ~28 and ~35 mm.
